parameters.content:
## 1. Intake & validation
Reject bad payloads before CRM or LLM calls.

## 2. Optional enrichment
Local domain/seniority only. No fake Clearbit success.

## 3. AI qualification
Official AI Agent + Groq Chat Model (`openai/gpt-oss-20b`).
Skipped honestly when `GROQ_API_KEY` / credential is missing.

## 4. CRM orchestration
Backend is source of truth for persist, qualify, priority.
HTTP Request stays here (no official FastAPI node).

## 4b. Google Sheets export
Write CRM header row then upsert by id. Tab CRM_AI must already exist.
Empty `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID` skips.

## 5. Routing & HITL
Hot and warm: Telegram sales alert.
Hot only: follow-up draft. Approve/reject in the dashboard; bot posts the decision.

## Error / review
Invalid payload, CRM errors, and failed `/qualify` stay on this row.

## Human approval
Prefer the dashboard HITL queue.
Optional: POST /webhook/lead-approve `{lead_id}` — CRM then Telegram, no WhatsApp.

options.systemMessage: You are a B2B sales qualification assistant. Do not invent contact details or URLs. Return JSON only with keys industry, intent (low|medium|high), product_fit (unknown|low|medium|high), priority (cold|warm|hot), pain_points (array of strings), summary, recommended_next_action.
